```{r}

full_raw_mat <- full_raw_mat |>
  distinct(gene_name,.keep_all = T) |>
  column_to_rownames("gene_name") |>
  as.matrix()
library(sva)

adjusted <- ComBat_seq(full_raw_mat, batch=metadata$batch, group=NULL) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  na.omit()

compute_logcpm <- function(count_mat) {
  dge <- edgeR::DGEList(counts = count_mat)
  keep <- rowSums(edgeR::cpm(dge) > 1) >= 5
  dge <- dge[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  dge <- edgeR::normLibSizes(dge, method = "TMMwsp")
  edgeR::cpm(dge, log = TRUE, prior.count = 1)
}

full_logcpm <- adjusted |>
  compute_logcpm() |>
  as.data.frame()

```


## Transcriptome-Based C1-Core Scores

## read the logCPM data

```{r}

rna_logcpm <- full_logcpm

```


## Scoring Setup

```{r}

# ============================================================
# C1 CORE SCORING: singscore + GSVA + consensus
# ============================================================

set.seed(RANDOM_SEED)

theme_set(theme_pubclean(base_size = 12))

pastel_score_cols <- c(
  "singscore" = "#9ecae1",
  "GSVA" = "#fdae6b",
  "consensus" = "#a1d99b"
)

pastel_group_cols <- c(
  "Not-C1-like" = "#bcbddc",
  "Not-C1-intermediate" = "#c7e9c0",
  "C1-intermediate" = "#fdd0a2",
  "C1-like" = "#fcbba1"
)

class_from_z <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x > 1 ~ "C1-like",
    x > 0 & x <= 1 ~ "C1-intermediate",
    x >= -1 & x <= 0 ~ "Not-C1-intermediate",
    x < -1 ~ "Not-C1-like",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

scale_numeric <- function(x) {
  as.numeric(scale(x))
}

c1_group_levels <- c(
  "Not-C1-like",
  "Not-C1-intermediate",
  "C1-intermediate",
  "C1-like"
)

```

## Prepare C1-Core Signature Inputs

```{r}

# ============================================================
# 1. Prepare expression matrix and C1-core genes
# ============================================================

c1_core <- vroom(
  "input/C1_Core_signature.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

c1_core_genes <- c1_core |>
  filter(C1_Core_direction %in% c("UP", "DOWN")) |>
  mutate(
    C1_Core_direction = toupper(C1_Core_direction)
  ) |>
  distinct(gene, C1_Core_direction)

c1_core_up <- c1_core_genes |>
  filter(C1_Core_direction == "UP") |>
  pull(gene) |>
  unique()

c1_core_down <- c1_core_genes |>
  filter(C1_Core_direction == "DOWN") |>
  pull(gene) |>
  unique()

c1_core_up_found <- intersect(c1_core_up, rownames(rna_logcpm))
c1_core_down_found <- intersect(c1_core_down, rownames(rna_logcpm))

c1_gene_coverage <- tibble(
  set = c("UP", "DOWN"),
  requested = c(length(c1_core_up), length(c1_core_down)),
  found = c(length(c1_core_up_found), length(c1_core_down_found)),
  missing = c(
    paste(base::setdiff(c1_core_up, rownames(rna_logcpm)), collapse = ";"),
    paste(base::setdiff(c1_core_down, rownames(rna_logcpm)), collapse = ";")
  )
)

c1_gene_coverage

write.csv(
c1_gene_coverage,
  "output/tables/C1_core_gene_coverage.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

```

## singscore-Based C1-Core Scoring

```{r}

# ============================================================
# 2. singscore C1-core scoring
# ============================================================

rank_data <- rankGenes(rna_logcpm)

c1_singscore_raw <- simpleScore(
  rankData = rank_data,
  upSet = c1_core_up_found,
  downSet = c1_core_down_found
)

c1_singscore <- c1_singscore_raw |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column("sample") |>
  transmute(
    sample,
    singscore_TotalScore = TotalScore,
    singscore_UpScore = UpScore,
    singscore_DownScore = DownScore,
    C1_singscore = scale_numeric(TotalScore)
  )

c1_singscore

summary(c1_singscore)

```

## GSVA-Based C1-Core Scoring

```{r}

# ============================================================
# 3. GSVA C1-core scoring
# ============================================================

c1_gene_sets <- list(
  C1_core_UP = c1_core_up_found,
  C1_core_DOWN = c1_core_down_found
)

gsva_par <- gsvaParam(
  exprData = data.matrix(rna_logcpm),
  geneSets = c1_gene_sets,
  kcdf = "Gaussian"
)

gsva_score_mat <- gsva(gsva_par)

c1_gsva <- gsva_score_mat |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column("gene_set") |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -gene_set,
    names_to = "sample",
    values_to = "gsva_score"
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = gene_set,
    values_from = gsva_score
  ) |>
  mutate(
    C1_GSVA_raw = C1_core_UP - C1_core_DOWN,
    C1_GSVA = scale_numeric(C1_GSVA_raw)
  ) |>
  select(
    sample,
    GSVA_UP = C1_core_UP,
    GSVA_DOWN = C1_core_DOWN,
    C1_GSVA_raw,
    C1_GSVA
  )

summary(c1_gsva)

```

## Consensus C1-Core Score

```{r}

# ============================================================
# 4. Consensus score
# ============================================================

c1_score_tbl <- c1_singscore |>
  inner_join(c1_gsva, by = "sample") |>
  mutate(
    C1_consensus = scale_numeric(rowMeans(
      cbind(C1_singscore, C1_GSVA),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )),
    C1_singscore_group = factor(class_from_z(C1_singscore), levels = c1_group_levels),
    C1_GSVA_group = factor(class_from_z(C1_GSVA), levels = c1_group_levels),
    C1_consensus_group = factor(class_from_z(C1_consensus), levels = c1_group_levels)
  ) |>
  as_tibble()

write.csv(
  c1_score_tbl,
  "output/tables/C1_core_singscore_GSVA_consensus_scores.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

c1_score_summary <- c1_score_tbl |>
  summarise(
    n_samples = n(),
    spearman_singscore_gsva = cor(C1_singscore, C1_GSVA, method = "spearman"),
    spearman_singscore_consensus = cor(C1_singscore, C1_consensus, method = "spearman"),
    spearman_gsva_consensus = cor(C1_GSVA, C1_consensus, method = "spearman")
  )

c1_score_summary

write.csv(
  c1_score_summary,
  "output/tables/C1_core_score_method_correlations.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

library(GGally)
p <- ggpairs(data = c1_score_tbl, columns = c("C1_singscore","C1_GSVA","C1_consensus"),
  lower = list(continuous = wrap("smooth_loess", se = T, color = "lightblue", alpha = 0.5)),
  upper = list(continuous = wrap("cor", size = 10,method = "spearman")),
  diag = list(continuous = wrap("densityDiag"))
) + 
  theme_bw(base_size = 15)

p

c1_score_tbl |>
  count(C1_singscore_group)

c1_score_tbl |>
  count(C1_GSVA_group)

c1_score_tbl |>
  count(C1_consensus_group)

c1_score_tbl <- c1_score_tbl |>
  mutate(sample = sample |>
    sub("_S\\d+$", "", x = _) |>
    sub("WTST\\d*$", "", x = _))

data.table::fwrite(x = c1_score_tbl,file = "output/tables//c1_core_groups.tsv",sep = "\t")

```


```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)

c1_score_tbl |>
  mutate(
    C1_consensus_group = factor(
      C1_consensus_group,
      levels = c(
        "Not-C1-like",
        "Not-C1-intermediate",
        "C1-intermediate",
        "C1-like"
      )
    ),
    sample = fct_reorder(sample, C1_consensus)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = sample,
    y = C1_consensus,
    colour = C1_consensus_group
  )) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(xend = sample, y = 0, yend = C1_consensus),
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -1,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey45",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 1,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey45",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
    geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    colour = "grey45",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not-C1-like"         = "#2166AC",
      "Not-C1-intermediate" = "#67A9CF",
      "C1-intermediate"     = "#FDAE61",
      "C1-like"             = "#B2182B"

    x = NULL,
```

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)

c1_cutoff <- quantile(c1_score_tbl$C1_consensus, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)

c1_score_tbl |>
  mutate(
    C1_class = factor(
      case_when(
        C1_consensus >= c1_cutoff ~ "C1",
        C1_consensus >= 0         ~ "C1-intermediate",
        TRUE                      ~ "Not-C1"
      ),
      levels = c("Not-C1", "C1-intermediate", "C1")
    ),
    sample = fct_reorder(sample, C1_consensus)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = sample, y = C1_consensus)) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(xend = sample, y = 0, yend = C1_consensus),
    colour = "grey70",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = C1_class), size = 3) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = c(0),
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey55",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = c(c1_cutoff),
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "#B2182B",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not-C1"         = "grey55",
      "C1-intermediate" = "#FDAE61",
      "C1"              = "#B2182B"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "C1 Core score",
    colour = "C1 class",
    title = "C1 Core score across samples",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "C1 defined as scores ≥ 75th percentile (",
      round(c1_cutoff, 2),
      "); intermediate scores range from 0 to the cutoff"
    )
  )

ggsave(
  filename = "output/figures/C1_Core_Class_75th.png",
  width = 16,
  height = 12,
  dpi = 300
)

```

```{r}

library(FactoMineR)
library(factoextra)
library(ggrepel)

set.seed(1234)
colnames(rna_logcpm) <- colnames(rna_logcpm) |>
  sub("_S\\d+$", "", x = _) |>
  sub("WTST\\d*$", "", x = _)

mat_t <- t(data.matrix(rna_logcpm))
res.pca <- PCA(mat_t, scale.unit = TRUE, graph = FALSE,ncp = 2)
# Variance explained by the first two axes.
eig_df <- factoextra::get_eig(res.pca)
pc1_var <- round(eig_df[1, "variance.percent"], 1)
pc2_var <- round(eig_df[2, "variance.percent"], 1)
pc <- as.data.frame(res.pca$ind$coord) |>
    rownames_to_column("sample") |>
  dplyr::rename(PC1 = Dim.1, PC2 = Dim.2)

pca_to_plot <- c1_score_tbl |>
    left_join(pc, by = "sample")


p_pca_C1 <- ggplot(pca_to_plot, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = C1_consensus_group)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = sample), size = 3, max.overlaps = 50) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not-C1-like"         = "#2166AC",
      "Not-C1-intermediate" = "#67A9CF",
      "C1-intermediate"     = "#FDAE61",
      "C1-like"             = "#B2182B"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = "RNA-seq QC: PCA Highlighting C1 Core group",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", pc1_var, "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", pc2_var, "%)"),
    color = "C1 Core group"
  )

p_pca_C1

ggsave(
  filename = file.path("output/figures/RNA_pca_C1.png"),
  plot = p_pca_C1,
  width = 12,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 600
)

```

```{r}

library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

small_genes <- c(
  "HOXB7","THY1","SCGB1A1","TEAD4","E2F4","MCM6","SF3B1",
  "E2F1","RRM2","NUDCD1","HSPG2","SCGB3A1","NKX2-1","SFTPC"
)

expr_keep <- rna_logcpm[rownames(rna_logcpm) %in% small_genes, , drop = FALSE]

expr_centered <- t(scale(t(expr_keep)))

anno <- c1_score_tbl |>
  filter(sample %in% colnames(expr_centered)) |>
  arrange(match(sample, colnames(expr_centered))) |>
  column_to_rownames("sample")

stopifnot(identical(rownames(anno), colnames(expr_centered)))

sample_order <- order(anno$C1_consensus)

group_cols <- c(
  "Not-C1-like"         = "#2166AC",
  "Not-C1-intermediate" = "#92C5DE",
  "C1-intermediate"     = "#F4A582",
  "C1-like"             = "#B2182B"
)

top_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  C1_score = anno$C1_consensus,
  C1_group = anno$C1_consensus_group,
  col = list(
    C1_score = colorRamp2(
      c(min(anno$C1_consensus, na.rm = TRUE), max(anno$C1_consensus, na.rm = TRUE)),
      c("#2166AC", "#B2182B")
    ),
    C1_group = group_cols
  ),
  na_col = "grey80"
)

library(viridisLite)

# Saturate colors above/below the 90th percentile
color_lim <- unname(
  quantile(abs(expr_centered), probs = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
)

expr_col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  seq(-color_lim, color_lim, length.out = 101),
  viridisLite::viridis(101)
)

ht <- Heatmap(
  expr_centered,
  name = "Expression",
  col = expr_col_fun,
  top_annotation = top_anno,
  column_order = sample_order,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  clustering_distance_rows = "pearson",
  clustering_method_rows = "average",
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  column_names_rot = 90,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  border = TRUE,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    at = c(-color_lim, 0, color_lim),
    labels = c("Low", "0", "High"),
    title = "Expression"
  )
)

png("output/figures/viridis_heatmap_small_genes.png", width = 3000, height = 1800, res = 200)
draw(ht,
  heatmap_legend_side = "right",
  annotation_legend_side = "right",
  merge_legends = TRUE)
dev.off()

draw(ht,  heatmap_legend_side = "right",
  annotation_legend_side = "right",
  merge_legends = TRUE)

```

### SecAct

```{r}

library(SecAct)
set.seed(RANDOM_SEED)
# SecAct infers cytokine activity from the matched RNA-seq matrix.
SecAct_scores <- SecAct.activity.inference(rna_logcpm)$zscore |>
  t() |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("sample") |>
  as_tibble()

SecAct_scores

write_tsv(SecAct_scores, "output/tables/SecAct_scores.tsv")

SecAct_scores <- SecAct_scores |>
    column_to_rownames("sample") |>
    t() |>
    as.data.frame()

SecAct_scores

```

```{r}

library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(dplyr)



# SecAct_scores:
# rows    = SecAct features
# columns = samples

SecAct_mat <- as.matrix(SecAct_scores)

# Keep samples shared between SecAct and C1 metadata
common_samples <- intersect(
  colnames(SecAct_mat),
  c1_score_tbl$sample
)

SecAct_mat <- SecAct_mat[
  ,
  common_samples,
  drop = FALSE
]

anno <- c1_score_tbl |>
  select(sample, C1_consensus, C1_consensus_group) |>
  filter(sample %in% common_samples) |>
  arrange(match(sample, common_samples)) |>
  column_to_rownames("sample")

stopifnot(
  identical(
    colnames(SecAct_mat),
    rownames(anno)
  )
)

# Correlate each SecAct feature with the C1 consensus score
secact_cor <- apply(
  SecAct_mat,
  1,
  function(x) {
    cor(
      x,
      anno$C1_consensus,
      method = "spearman",
      use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
    )
  }
)

cor_tbl <- tibble(
  feature = names(secact_cor),
  correlation = unname(secact_cor)
) |>
  filter(is.finite(correlation))

# Select 25 strongest positive correlations
top_positive <- cor_tbl |>
  filter(correlation > 0) |>
  slice_max(
    order_by = correlation,
    n = 25,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) |>
  mutate(direction = "Positive")

# Select 25 strongest negative correlations
top_negative <- cor_tbl |>
  filter(correlation < 0) |>
  slice_min(
    order_by = correlation,
    n = 25,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) |>
  mutate(direction = "Negative")

selected_cor <- bind_rows(
  top_positive,
  top_negative
)

write_tsv(
  selected_cor,
  "output/tables/SecAct_top25_positive_top25_negative_C1_correlations.tsv"
)

selected_cor

# Explicit row order:
# strongest positive first, strongest negative last
positive_features <- top_positive |>
  arrange(desc(correlation)) |>
  pull(feature)

negative_features <- top_negative |>
  arrange(correlation) |>
  pull(feature)

selected_features <- c(
  positive_features,
  negative_features
)

SecAct_selected <- SecAct_mat[
  selected_features,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

# Row-wise Z-score for visualization
SecAct_scaled <- t(scale(t(SecAct_selected)))

# Remove any zero-variance rows that became non-finite
valid_rows <- apply(
  SecAct_scaled,
  1,
  function(x) any(is.finite(x))
)

SecAct_scaled <- SecAct_scaled[
  valid_rows,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

selected_cor <- selected_cor |>
  filter(feature %in% rownames(SecAct_scaled))

# Match row annotations to heatmap order
row_anno_df <- selected_cor |>
  arrange(match(feature, rownames(SecAct_scaled))) |>
  column_to_rownames("feature")

stopifnot(
  identical(
    rownames(row_anno_df),
    rownames(SecAct_scaled)
  )
)

# Order samples from low to high C1 score
sample_order <- order(
  anno$C1_consensus,
  na.last = TRUE
)

group_cols <- c(
  "Not-C1-like"         = "#2166AC",
  "Not-C1-intermediate" = "#92C5DE",
  "C1-intermediate"     = "#F4A582",
  "C1-like"             = "#B2182B"
)

top_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  C1_score = anno$C1_consensus,
  C1_group = anno$C1_consensus_group,
  col = list(
    C1_score = colorRamp2(
      range(anno$C1_consensus, na.rm = TRUE),
      c("#2166AC", "#B2182B")
    ),
    C1_group = group_cols
  ),
  na_col = "grey80"
)

# Saturate the most extreme 5% of scaled values
color_lim <- unname(
  quantile(
    abs(SecAct_scaled),
    probs = 0.95,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
)

activity_col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(-color_lim, 0, color_lim),
  c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B")
)

row_split <- factor(
  row_anno_df$direction,
  levels = c("Positive", "Negative")
)

ht <- Heatmap(
  SecAct_scaled,
  name = "Relative\nactivity",
  col = activity_col_fun,

  top_annotation = top_anno,

  column_order = sample_order,
  row_split = row_split,

  cluster_columns = FALSE,

  # Keep the correlation-based row ordering
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_row_slices = TRUE,
  clustering_distance_rows = "pearson",
  clustering_method_rows = "average",

  show_column_names = TRUE,
  column_names_rot = 90,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8),

  border = TRUE,
  na_col = "grey90",

  row_title = c(
    "Positive correlation",
    "Negative correlation"
  ),

  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    at = c(-color_lim, 0, color_lim),
    labels = c("Low", "0", "High"),
    title = "Relative\nactivity"
  )
)

png(
  "output/figures/SecAct_top25_positive_top25_negative_C1_heatmap.png",
  width = 3200,
  height = 2400,
  res = 200
)

draw(
  ht,
  heatmap_legend_side = "right",
  annotation_legend_side = "right",
  merge_legends = TRUE
)

dev.off()

draw(
  ht,
  heatmap_legend_side = "right",
  annotation_legend_side = "right",
  merge_legends = TRUE
)

```


## Metabolic Flux

### METAFlux

```{r}
set.seed(RANDOM_SEED)

library(METAFlux)

raw_data <- adjusted |>
    as.matrix()

expr_metaflux <- log1p(raw_data)

# medium file for human derived samples
data("human_blood")
data("human_gem")
#Calculate mras for human sample data
scores<-calculate_reaction_score(expr_metaflux)
#Calculate flux for human sample data
flux<-compute_flux(mras=scores,medium=human_blood) 

#optional: flux scores cubic root normalization
cbrt <- function(x) {
    sign(x) * abs(x)^(1/3)
}

flux=cbrt(flux)

flux |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column("flux") |>
  write_tsv("output/tables/LUAD_METAFlux_Flux.tsv")

data("nutrient_lookup_files")

library(dplyr)

subsystem_map <- human_gem |>
  select(ID, SUBSYSTEM) |>
  filter(
    ID %in% rownames(flux),
    !is.na(SUBSYSTEM),
    SUBSYSTEM != ""
  )

flux_sub <- flux[subsystem_map$ID, , drop = FALSE]

pathway_sum <- rowsum(
  x = abs(flux_sub),
  group = subsystem_map$SUBSYSTEM,
  reorder = FALSE
)

n_rxn <- table(subsystem_map$SUBSYSTEM)

pathway_score <- sweep(
  pathway_sum,
  1,
  n_rxn[rownames(pathway_sum)],
  "/"
)

pathway_score |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column("flux") |>
  write_tsv("output/tables/LUAD_METAFlux_pathway_score.tsv")


```

```{r}

library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)
```

```{r}
# Cell types × samples
ctme_mat <- as.matrix(CTME_deconv_singScore)

# Match shared samples
common_samples <- intersect(colnames(ctme_mat), c1_score_tbl$sample)

ctme_mat <- ctme_mat[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]

anno <- c1_score_tbl |>
  select(sample, C1_consensus, C1_consensus_group) |>
  filter(sample %in% common_samples) |>
  arrange(match(sample, common_samples)) |>
  column_to_rownames("sample")

stopifnot(identical(colnames(ctme_mat), rownames(anno)))

# Correlation with C1 consensus using raw singScore values
ctme_cor <- apply(
  ctme_mat,
  1,
  \(x) cor(
    x,
    anno$C1_consensus,
    method = "pearson",
    use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
  )
)

cor_tbl <- tibble(
  cell_type = names(ctme_cor),
  correlation = unname(ctme_cor)
) |>
  filter(is.finite(correlation)) |>
  arrange(desc(correlation)) |>
  mutate(
    direction = if_else(
      correlation >= 0,
      "Positive",
      "Negative"
    )
  )

write_tsv(
  cor_tbl,
  "output/tables/CTME_C1_correlations.tsv"
)

# Order rows by correlation
ctme_selected <- ctme_mat[
  cor_tbl$cell_type,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

# Row Z-score only for visualization
ctme_scaled <- t(scale(t(ctme_selected)))

valid_rows <- apply(
  ctme_scaled,
  1,
  \(x) all(is.finite(x))
)

ctme_scaled <- ctme_scaled[valid_rows, , drop = FALSE]

cor_tbl <- cor_tbl |>
  filter(cell_type %in% rownames(ctme_scaled)) |>
  arrange(match(cell_type, rownames(ctme_scaled)))

# Order columns from low to high C1 score
sample_order <- order(anno$C1_consensus, na.last = TRUE)

group_cols <- c(
  "Not-C1-like"         = "#2166AC",
  "Not-C1-intermediate" = "#92C5DE",
  "C1-intermediate"     = "#F4A582",
  "C1-like"             = "#B2182B"
)

top_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  C1_score = anno$C1_consensus,
  C1_group = anno$C1_consensus_group,
  col = list(
    C1_score = colorRamp2(
      range(anno$C1_consensus, na.rm = TRUE),
      c("#2166AC", "#B2182B")
    ),
    C1_group = group_cols
  ),
  na_col = "grey80"
)

# Compressed blue–white–red scale
color_lim <- unname(
  quantile(abs(ctme_scaled), 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
)

col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(-color_lim, 0, color_lim),
  c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B")
)

row_split <- factor(

)

ht <- Heatmap(

  name = "Relative\ncell score",

  ),
```
